domains.title: Ranginui
domains.subtitle: Sky
domains.lead: Ranginui is sky, fatherhood, creation. The name means "'Great heaven' (Māori rangi 'sky, heavens' + nui 'great'), the sky father prised apart from the earth mother Papatūānuku by their children." and belongs to the polynesian tradition.

mythology.lead: The stories of Ranginui place sky, fatherhood, creation at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Ranginui appears in polynesian tradition as sky, fatherhood, creation. The name's meaning, "'Great heaven' (Māori rangi 'sky, heavens' + nui 'great'), the sky father prised apart from the earth mother Papatūānuku by their children.", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Ranginui in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Ranginui remains a touchstone for understanding polynesian religion, art, and identity.
